Design package: [/tmp/exposed-duckdb-resolution-20261009/design/astra/design.md](/tmp/exposed-duckdb-resolution-20261009/design/astra/design.md).

Proposes one deep scorer adapter, immutable generated bundle, per-call private DuckDB connection, generated budget count before prediction, and typed private execution provenance. Keeps existing `ScoredPairs::checked` and domain expansion ownership.

Flags native engine pinning and array binding as early proof points; proposes parameterized JSON-to-list conversion to avoid assuming `Vec<String>: ToSql` support. No repository edits.
